result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is a noticeable layout issue at the bottom: the last restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look cut off and less usable.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so part of the content is hidden off-screen.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or margin to the scrollable content so the last card sits fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal category row on the right edge is partially cut off, which makes the last chip look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Allow a bit more horizontal padding or make the scroll affordance clearer so partially visible chips feel intentional.
